channel.title: Congress Report Card weekly digest
channel.description: Missed votes, grade changes and bills that became law, every Saturday.

item.title: Week ending October 31, 2026
item.description:
Here is what changed in the public record of Congress from October 24 to October 31, 2026.

Votes this week

Neither chamber held a roll-call vote this week.

Grade changes

7 members moved to a different letter grade. Bill scores are ranked within each chamber, so a grade can move when other members' records change.

Biggest gains

  • Mary Gay Scanlon (D, PA-5): B- to B
  • Emilia Strong Sykes (D, OH-13): C+ to B-
  • Kevin Mullin (D, CA-15): C- to C

Biggest drops

  • Michael R. Turner (R, OH-10): D+ to D
  • David J. Taylor (R, OH-2): B+ to B
  • Ed Case (D, HI-1): B+ to B
  • Matt Van Epps (R, TN-7): C to C-

See every member's grade at congressreportcard.org, or read how grades are calculated.
